# Softcurse Systems

> Official website for Softcurse Systems: software tools, games, experiments, chronicles, and localization work.

## Main directories

- [Home](https://softcursesystems.pages.dev/): Company overview and featured projects.
- [Lab](https://softcursesystems.pages.dev/lab): Software, applications, developer tools, and experiments.
- [Studio](https://softcursesystems.pages.dev/studio): Games and interactive projects.
- [Localization](https://softcursesystems.pages.dev/localization): Translation and localization projects.
- [Chronicles](https://softcursesystems.pages.dev/chronicles): Softcurse narrative works.
- [Blog](https://softcursesystems.pages.dev/blog): Engineering and development articles.
- [Roadmap](https://softcursesystems.pages.dev/roadmap): Public project milestones.

## Featured projects

- [Fake Checker](https://softcursesystems.pages.dev/studio/fakechecker): Browser-based dystopian information-review simulation.
- [HexBrewers from Ashenveil](https://softcursesystems.pages.dev/studio/hexbrewers): Dark-fantasy bag-building strategy game in development.
- [GELA](https://softcursesystems.pages.dev/lab/gela): Offline-first Georgian voice control for Windows.
- [Codex Pixel](https://softcursesystems.pages.dev/lab/codex-pixel): Softcurse visual workspace for Codex agent activity.
